targets.expr: sum by (service_name) ((rate(truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"5..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[5m]) + (((min_over_time(truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"5..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[5m]) unless truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"5..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"} offset 5m) unless (last_over_time(truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"5..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[1d] offset 5m) unless on() (count_over_time(up{job="otel-collector-metrics"}[2m] offset 5m) > 0))) or rate(truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"5..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[5m]) * 0) / 300))

sum by (service_name) ((rate(truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"4..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[5m]) + (((min_over_time(truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"4..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[5m]) unless truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"4..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"} offset 5m) unless (last_over_time(truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"4..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[1d] offset 5m) unless on() (count_over_time(up{job="otel-collector-metrics"}[2m] offset 5m) > 0))) or rate(truvag3_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", http_request_method="POST", http_response_status_code=~"4..", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[5m]) * 0) / 300))

panels.title: Service Registrations (range)
panels.description: Service registrations counted over the selected range. Only services whose telemetry starts before their component report this today (framework issue C4). Counter-derived estimates can over- or under-count: Prometheus extrapolates between scrapes, and missing per-pod identity can conceal restarts. Not billing/audit totals.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) ((increase(truvag3_discovery_registrations_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[$__range]) + (((min_over_time(truvag3_discovery_registrations_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[$__range]) unless truvag3_discovery_registrations_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"} offset $__range) unless (last_over_time(truvag3_discovery_registrations_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[1d] offset $__range) unless on() (count_over_time(up{job="otel-collector-metrics"}[2m] offset $__range) > 0))) or increase(truvag3_discovery_registrations_count{job="otel-collector-metrics", service_type=~"${service_type:raw}"}[$__range]) * 0)))

sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"truvag3-examples|software-maintenance", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) and on (pod) topk(15, sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"truvag3-examples|software-maintenance", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__range] @ end())))
